question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

__Monika said to her mother that, "I have passed the examination."__

options.text: Monika said to her mother that, "I am passed"
Monika said to her mother, "I have passed the examination"
Monika said to her mother that, "she has passed"

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (2).**
